owned.api: Finite exact Python float/int/bool radii within [2^-96, 2^96]. Native binary64 volume and Carlson integral. General finite typed scalar inputs preserve NumPy arithmetic before the owned integral where transformed arguments fit.
owned.arithmetic: Volume multiplies in caller order; only elliptic-integral inputs sort. Sphere short circuit; common R_F/R_D duplication for spheroids and triaxial.
owned.surface: With the median chosen as z, the R_D contribution in DLMF 19.21.10 is nonnegative. Normalization avoids large intermediate differences. Equations DLMF 19.21.10, 19.26.18, 19.36.1–2.
owned.platform: Scalar and serial, independent of process-global workers. No SIMD branch.

providers.numpy: Preserves typed scalar arithmetic, promotions, casting and scalar representations.
providers.scipy.special.elliprg: Only transformed integral arguments outside the native finite/provider precision route, including exceptional values and extended scalar types.
providers.compatibility: Array and arbitrary object protocols retain original configured compatibility and warnings.

parity_policy.volume: exact finite scalar values and type
parity_policy.special: exact error and non-fallback warning class/text, infinity and NaN classifications

timing.boundary: Original and candidate public-call tuple construction and consumption, same chosen scalar recipes; no provider or array timing claim.
